top_signals.title: Japan Life Insurers Swap Into Higher-Yield Bonds to Lift Returns
top_signals.summary: Japan’s life insurers are swapping out of lower-yielding bonds into higher-yielding debt as elevated yields create opportunities to boost portfolio returns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: BlackRock's Rieder on Global Bonds, AI
top_signals.summary: Rick Rieder, CIO for Global Fixed Income at BlackRock, discusses his outlook for global rates and bonds, as well as the outlook for the fundraising on AI, as companies look to raise capital for infrastructure build-out. He speaks exclusively with Paul Allen and Haidi Stroud Watts on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: LDP proposes gradual reduction of fuel subsidies
top_signals.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has ordered industry minister Ryosei Akazawa to consider reviewing the subsidy program.
